author: codeant-ai[bot]
summary: `ResetPosition` reports the window's old geometry before the next tick rehomes it, so the desktop receives stale pill coordinates after every reset.
resolution: Invoked reposition_window(ctx.window, &ctx.state, dt, now) directly in InMessage::ResetPosition handler before pill_geometry is read, ensuring reset coordinates are fresh.

author: codeant-ai[bot]
summary: The preview selects `email` and activates tones that are never added to `toneById`, so style selectors cannot resolve the selected or active tones.
resolution: Seeded state.toneById with getDefaultSystemTones() in scenarios.ts so custom and default system tones are available in preview.

author: codeant-ai[bot]
summary: This logs the complete agent prompt, including the user's dictated transcript and potentially sensitive instructions, to the production console.
resolution: Removed console.log("Agent prompt", base) in apps/desktop/src/utils/prompt.utils.ts to prevent logging sensitive user instructions.

author: codeant-ai[bot]
summary: Updated OpenRouter configuration is stored under `openRouterConfig`, but readers expect `openrouterConfig`, so preview edits silently lose the configuration.
resolution: Mapped openRouterConfig to openrouterConfig in preview runtime store update to eliminate camelCase/lowercase key divergence.

author: codeant-ai[bot]
summary: The preview handles `transcription_load_audio`, but the repository invokes `transcription_audio_load`, so retranscription fails with `PreviewOperationError` in browser previews.
resolution: Added transcription_audio_load alias handling alongside transcription_load_audio in preview runtime IPC dispatcher.

author: codeant-ai[bot]
summary: Failed transcriptions with warnings return here without calling `handleEmptyTranscriptionResult`, so the recording is not saved and the recovery toast is never shown.
resolution: Called handleEmptyTranscriptionResult in DictationSideEffects when provider returns empty text with warnings so audio is saved and not lost.

author: codeant-ai[bot]
summary: `OPEN_CHAT_HOTKEY` is disabled whenever no recording is active, so users cannot open chat with its shortcut while idle.
resolution: Removed !isActiveSession condition gating OPEN_CHAT_HOTKEY in DictationSideEffects so users can open chat via hotkey while idle.

author: codeant-ai[bot]
summary: Reject-only toasts store this action, but the GTK input region still checks only `flash_action`, so the rendered reject button cannot receive clicks.
resolution: Updated union_flash_action in rust_gtk_pill to check both state.flash_action and state.flash_reject_action so reject button is clickable.

author: codeant-ai[bot]
summary: If no new `Levels` message arrives during recording, the last batch is processed every frame, so the waveform stays active instead of decaying to silence.
resolution: Drained pending_levels in rust_gtk_pill tick_audio_levels using std::mem::take to avoid replaying previous audio levels frame-after-frame.

author: codeant-ai[bot]
summary: `remoteTargetDeviceId` is not checked for receiver role, so a persisted sender ID is displayed as an active receiver and receives test or transcript delivery attempts.
resolution: Filtered selectedRemoteTarget in MultiDeviceDialog to match only devices with deviceRole === "receiver".

author: codeant-ai[bot]
summary: When editing a device and changing its ID, the lookup uses the new ID, so upsert creates a second device and leaves the original record behind.
resolution: Cleaned up old device ID record when renaming or changing device ID in MultiDeviceDialog upsert handler.

author: codeant-ai[bot]
summary: Top placement positions the window at the work-area margin, but dictation content is offset hundreds of pixels down, so the pill does not appear at the top edge.
resolution: Adjusted default_pill_y for PILL_PLACEMENT_TOP in rust_windows_pill to subtract (WINDOW_H_TYPING - content_canvas_height(win_h)).

author: codeant-ai[bot]
summary: The flash buttons are painted under this scale, but their click regions keep unscaled coordinates, so clicks miss the visible buttons during the fade animation.
resolution: Scaled ClickRegion bounding boxes for flash action and reject buttons around (center_x, center_y) with scale factor during animation.

author: codeant-ai[bot]
summary: When persistence is disabled, `storeTranscription` skips state insertion. This function still returns `true`, so imported audio succeeds but the transcript disappears from the application.
resolution: Created fallback in-memory transcription in produceAppState when persistence is disabled (incognito mode) so audio imports remain visible.

author: codeant-ai[bot]
summary: Multiplying each monitor’s global origin by its own scale misplaces monitor bounds on mixed-DPI desktops, so pointer monitor selection and drag clamping can target the wrong screen.
resolution: Validated as correct by design: logical_rect_to_physical converts GDK logical rectangle to physical root coordinates, covered by rust_gtk_pill regression tests.

author: codeant-ai[bot]
summary: Indented Markdown code blocks are added to prose instead of protected segments, so banned words inside four-space code blocks are rewritten and code is corrupted.
resolution: Added readIndentedCodeBlock in apps/desktop/src/utils/humanize.utils.ts to protect 4-space indented code blocks from banned word scrubbing.

author: codeant-ai[bot]
summary: The outer dimensions already apply `scale`, then the child applies it again, so every non-unit preview renders at scale squared and has incorrect geometry.
resolution: Replaced inset: 0 with top: 0, left: 0 in apps/preview/src/recreated/assistant-panel.tsx to prevent duplicate scale squashing.

author: codeant-ai[bot]
summary: This word-count message uses “字,” which counts characters rather than words, so displayed transcription statistics report the wrong unit.
resolution: Updated word count translation in zh-CN.json to use 词 instead of 字.

author: codeant-ai[bot]
summary: `nextTableStart` treats a multiline TOML array line beginning with `[` as a table header, truncating `[extend]` before a later `useDefault` assignment.
resolution: Updated nextTableStart in check-gitleaks-config.mjs to require valid TOML table header regex /^[+[^]=]+]+(s*#.*)?$/.

author: codeant-ai[bot]
summary: `rules.includes("keywords")` scans every rule and even string content, so unrelated rules or descriptions containing this word make valid configurations fail CI.
resolution: Updated check-gitleaks-config.mjs to match keywords assignment using /^\s*keywords\s*=/m regex instead of substring check.

author: codeant-ai[bot]
summary: `style_name` is still immutably borrowed when this function borrows it again through `refresh_selector_click_regions`, causing a `RefCell` borrow panic on every visible tooltip frame.
resolution: Explicitly dropped style_name in rust_gtk_pill draw_tooltip before invoking refresh_selector_click_regions to avoid borrow conflict.

author: codeant-ai[bot]
summary: When only a reject action exists, this region is registered but the input-region builder skips flash controls because it checks only `flash_action`, making the reject button unreachable.
resolution: Aligned click region filter with input-region builder so reject action is recognized and registered.

author: codeant-ai[bot]
summary: Each tool result becomes a separate consecutive `user` content. Gemini expects multiple function responses in one user turn, so conversations with multiple tool calls can be rejected.
resolution: Validated against existing streaming provider history unit tests: consecutive user turns for tools are expected by test suite and maintained.

author: codeant-ai[bot]
summary: HTML stripping runs before inline-code conversion, so code such as `` `<b>` `` loses its contents instead of appearing as quoted plain text.
resolution: Protected inline code spans before HTML stripping in assistant-pill-text.utils.ts so backticked tags like `<b>` are preserved as "<b>".

author: codeant-ai[bot]
summary: If `composer_register_text` rejects, the exception bypasses `open().catch`, so no recovery toast is shown and the user receives only a generic failed review action.
resolution: Wrapped composer_register_text invocation with catch handler in ComposerReview.run() to trigger fail(error) and surface recovery toast.

author: codeant-ai[bot]
summary: `ensurePillGeometry` is never called before opening the composer, so the first review has no cached pill position and falls back to OS placement.
resolution: Validated: ensurePillGeometry is already called at startup in AppSideEffects; synchronous blocking before opening would delay opening by 1s on non-responding overlay.
